q: Hausdorff measure ℋˢ is an outer measure on ℝⁿ. Its key property relating to Lebesgue measure is:
opts: ℋⁿ = Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ (up to a constant)
ℋˢ is not σ-finite for any s
exp: ℋⁿ equals the n-dimensional Lebesgue measure up to the constant ω_n/2^n (where ω_n is the volume of the unit ball). Hausdorff dimension of a set is the critical exponent where ℋˢ jumps from ∞ to 0.
